events.verdict: Queen (ORL) is moving alongside Maxey's (PHI) path when incidental body contact occurs during the drive.
Gordon (PHI) initiates contact across Banchero's (ORL) right arm and causes him to lose control of the ball during his upward shooting motion.
Queen (ORL) is turning slightly prior to marginal body contact occurring as Maxey (PHI) gathers the ball and attempts the shot.
Banchero (ORL) and Oubre Jr. (PHI) each make contact with the ball prior to incidental contact occurring during the rebound.
Edwards (PHI) initiates contact across Banchero's (ORL) right arm and affects his dunk attempt.
Yabusele (PHI) extends his forearm into Isaac's (ORL) back and initiates contact that causes him to become dislodged.
Gordon (PHI) takes a step backward following the initial contact with Queen (ORL) during the screen and further marginal contact occurs as Queen attempts to move over it.
Maxey (PHI) makes clean contact with the ball to momentarily dislodge it away from Anthony (ORL) during the drive.
Black (ORL) is imminently exiting the lane within three seconds.

Isaac (ORL) steps into the lane and the three-second count is stopped when the ball is deflected. When Anthony (ORL) regains possession, the count resumes and the shot is imminent within three seconds.
Maxey's (PHI) hands come forward toward Queen's (ORL) front and marginal contact occurs as Queen secures the rebound.
Anthony (ORL) and Gordon (PHI) engage and disengage with one another as Gordon sets the pick at the top of the perimeter.
Queen (ORL) legally contests Maxey's (PHI) jump shot attempt.
Maxey (PHI) commits a take foul on Banchero (ORL).
Oubre Jr. (PHI) does not inbound the ball within five seconds.
